description: WAMSI Node 6.1 - Offshore and coastal engineering and the effects of climate change - Summary is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Western Australian Marine Science Institution. WAMSI Node 6. 1 deals with the modelling of past and future sea level / storm surge and waves. Western Australia is vulnerable to climate change impacts which may alter the prevailing wind conditions. The altered wind fields will have a strong influence on the wind wave climate and in the generation of storm surges. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Western Australian Marine Science Institution. It offers 2 resource(s) in netcdf, pdf. The portal shows 2025-09-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 3.0 Australia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
